I've been part of this community since 1999, a volunteer admin about a year after that, de facto in charge of it about a year after that, and officially owner/operator of the site since 2004. It's not the path to a balanced lifestyle, generally, forum running. It was solitude and hell after that for quite some time in my personal life, and I only barely pulled myself out of that with enormous effort and stubbornness back in 2009-2012 or so. After that I needed to live life some and make up for lost time.. Doing so wasn't always in balance with what NeoGAF needed, admittedly, but I kept trying to do right by the community along the way.

I'm still here and I'm not going anywhere.
